ngaap.guidance: Guidance now reflects the Communications business as discontinued operations in all periods. Q3-15: adjusted diluted EPS from continuing operations $1.00-$1.04 (GAAP cont. ops $0.89-$0.93; amortization $101m pretax/$77m after-tax/$0.11). FY2015: adjusted diluted EPS from continuing operations raised to $4.25-$4.33 from $4.23-$4.33 (GAAP cont. ops $3.82-$3.90; Nobel inventory $0.02; other discrete tax items ($0.02); amortization $400m pretax/$306m after-tax/$0.43). Reclassifying Communications to discontinued ops reduces H1-15 adjusted EPS by $0.03; 26m DHR shares tendered in the exchange reduce the share count prospectively.
ngaap.notes: 2015 definition: adjusted diluted EPS adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets (new from 2015; tax-effected per item in the bridge labels) and excludes items such as acquisition fair-value inventory/deferred revenue adjustments, significant transaction costs, investment gains, separation costs and discrete tax items. Primary bridge is the as-reported (total company, Communications included) reconciliation: 0.97 -> 1.08. The release also gives a second reconciliation treating Communications as discontinued (stored in alt_bridge_contops): GAAP 0.97, less (income) loss from discontinued operations +0.03 = continuing ops 1.00 -> adjusted cont. ops 1.08 (Q2-14 recast 1.01 vs 1.03 as reported; amortization ex-Communications $99m pretax/$76m after-tax, Q2-14 $86m/$65m). No FCF table.
